backup.chooseTitle: Choose the folder for the backup
backup.none: Your project is not backed up yet.
backup.intro: Versions protect you from your own mistakes. A backup protects you when the computer breaks or is lost: the project is copied regularly as a zip file into a folder of your choice. It is best to choose a folder that Dropbox, iCloud Drive, OneDrive or Nextcloud syncs, or an external drive.
backup.listEmpty: There are no backups of this project in that folder yet.
backup.how: Automatic: at most once an hour if something changed, and when the project closes. The newest 10 backups are kept, then one per day (two weeks), per week (three months) and per month (two years); older ones go to the trash. To get a backup back, unzip the file.
backup.unreachable: The backup folder cannot be reached: {folder}. Is the drive connected?
backup.problem.inside: The backup folder must not be inside the project. Choose a folder outside it.
backup.problem.unwritable: That folder cannot be written to. Choose another one.

backup.restoredAt: Restored as a new project in {path}. Your previous project is unchanged (under “Recent”). You can set up a backup of its own for this project under “Versions and backup”.
